content: April 17, 2024 Overdose Prevention Resources How to use these resources These resources can help supplement efforts to prevent overdose and substance use related harms. Use and share content and images on overdose prevention and opioid prescribing. Access resources about the importance of overdose prevention and stay up to date with news from the Division of Overdose Prevention. Resources Data Resources View fatal and nonfatal overdose data dashboards, and pharmacy dispensing rate maps. May 6, 2024 Digital Media Toolkits Digital media toolkits help partners communicate the importance of drug overdose prevention. May 2, 2024 Pressroom CDC press releases on overdose prevention and opioid prescribing.
